lines.en: Beach.
: WE FINALLY MADE IT!
: I can’t believe we’re actually at the beach!
: Rock on!
: That was the longest car ride of my life! And also thankfully not the last!
: Rock on!
: I guess now we need to figure out how we’re going to spend our time.
: I want to build a sand castle!
: I want to eat ice cream!
: I want my mom back!
: (symbolism)
: I sure hope we have enough time for all of these fun activities. The last thing any of us needs is a little more sunburn.
: You’ve got that right, Dad! Sensitive skin runs in our family, and I don’t want to go back home looking like one of the red types of shellfish!
: Shellfish aren’t red until you cook them, Arnold!
: Don’t call me Arnold, Arnold!
: No, really! It’s because heat denatures a protein in their shells called crustacyanin that masks the natural red-orange pigment called astaxanthin and makes them brighter!
: You’re only saying that because you’re coated in your own natural lubricant that makes it impossible for you get sunburnt at all!
: Oh, Ami! You know me so well!
: I guess that’s why they call it a CAT-fish!
: She said the line!
: How come Ayane gets her own catchphrase but I don’t?! I’m the main character and she’s just my friend who comes over to use the bath sometimes!
: It must be the results of the latest popularity poll. You’re lacking when it comes to male voters age 35-45.
: But Maya was the popular one before either of us and she’s thriving now.
: (thriving)
: She seems kind of green to me.
: I guess that’s why they call it a CAT-fish!
: Okay, that’s it! I’m going to start my fun beach vacation without either of you!
: With ice cream?
: More like NICE cream!
: Stop being popular! This is my show!
: Now please excuse me while I impress you all with my latent diving ability!
: Ami, no! The last time you showed everyone your latent diving ability, you got sucked into a vortex!
: Look, guys! I can fly now!
: DAMN IT AYANEEEEEEEEEEE!
: Ah! And I’m being sucked into quicksand!
: DAMN IT QUICKSANNNNNNNNNNNNND!
: Ami, help! This sand is so much faster than normal! I’m not ready to be a short king!
: No can do, Dadsei! I’ve gotta show everyone my latent diving ability for REAL this time! No more messing around!
:  WHEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!
: Okay! Just be careful. That bucket looks particularly violent today!
: I’M GOING SO FAST!
: You just need to know how to do it! Watch!
: First, you-
: Oh no! I must have made a mistake! I’m being sucked in!
:  SUPERRRRR AYANEEEEEEEEE!
: AMI!
: Dad, help! The beach bucket is making me feel weird! I’m supposed to be good at diving!
: And I’m supposed to be taller! Is the beach actually evil?!
: AHAHAHAHAHAGAHAHAGABHGHGAHAHAHH!!!!!!!!!
: Ami!
: IT IS CHANGING ME!
: Ami!
: Everyone, look! Check out my latent diving ability!
: CURSE YOU, POPULARITY POLL!!!!!
: Ami!
: (not currently pictured)
: I guess that’s why they call it a CAT-fish!
: Almost there! Make sure to watch me, Sensei!
: I can’t! The sand is claiming me!
: Then I’ll come rescue you right after my dive! Here I go!
: Ami! I mean- Arnold!
: WHEEEEEEEEEE-
: Ack!
: Nice dive, future sex!
: Pfhbfhbfht! What the heck?! This isn’t water at all! It’s just a blue image layer!
: What?! You mean to tell me we came all the way here for blue?! We have blue at home!
: I wanted to be a wet boy!
: Oh, it’s actually blue raspberry flavored. Sensei! The beach is good again!
: Okay! But I’m not! Could you lend me a hand, please?!
: Did somebody ask for HAND?
: Woah! Big hand!
: Ayane! I’m okay now! You can keep your hands!
: Okay, Sensei! That’s actually great news because the blue raspberry image layer is trying to eat me!
: What?!
: I SAID THE BLUE RASPBERRY IMAGE LAYER IS TRYING TO EAT ME! THE BEACH IS EVIL AGAIN!
: Oh, okay! Good luck!
: GUYYYYYYSSSSS! OVER HEREEEEEEE!
: The beach bucket leads to a magic circle just beyond a section of the beach guided by an assortment of spiderlike creatures! Come help!
: We can not for we are fighting our own battles just the same!
: Maya! Do something! Only you can save me!
: (vibing)
: GRAAAAAAHAHHHAHAHHhh! I’M MORPHING AGAIN! WHY WON’T SOMEONE TEACH ME HOW TO CONTROL THIS!?!?!??!! CUT TO COMMERCIAL!
: NOT LIKE THISSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSS!!!!!!!!!!
: So this is what my life has come to.
: Had I had only known the beach was evil, I never would have sat in that car for five years, further endangering the life of my family on my journey toward being a wet boy.
: If anyone ever finds my body, let them know this — I enjoyed life. And in my next one, I hope to be faster than the sand.
: I have escaped the blue!
: I wonder if I’d turn to glass if I swallowed enough of this before being cremated?
: NOTHING VENTURED, NOTHING GAINED.
: Sensei, wait! Do not eat the sand yet, for I have come to rescue you.
: Ayane? How are you moving like that? I thought animations were only for sex.
: Because I’m an object of favoritism and not bound by the same constraints everyone else is!
: I think I need to get better at walking, though. This sand sure is quick!
: Well, DUH. How do you think I got into this mess in the first place?!
: Say, have you seen the other Arnold around here? Whatever happened after she jumped into the beach bucket?
: She’s been crying for help inside of some magic circle just beyond the spider imagery.
: It may be easier to rescue her with my flying. Should I-
: No! I want to spend private beach time with you! Ami is merely an obstacle!
: (Gasp!) Sensei! For real?! It’s not just because I can move like this, is it?
: You can move in all sorts of ways. That’s why I love you. And why I’ve welcomed you into this family despite you not being my real daughter.
: It’s not just because I give awesome head?
: Is that supposed to be a pun?
: HAHAHEHEHAHA! I’m also funny! And have guns! The real heroine has been me the whole time! Welcome to the Ayane show! Now, it’s time to- ah!
: Sensei! Where are you going?!
: Now that I am free, I refuse to let the sand catch me again! Arakawa secret technique — ninja legs!
: You’ve been a ninja this whole time and you’ve never told me?!
: That’s right! Just try handling this massive burst of speed!
: But we were supposed to have private beach time alone where I can give you awesome head and you can be like, “Wow, Ayane! Good job!” and then let me drink all your milk!
: This cow’s run its last race, babe! And if you want milk, you’re gonna have to go to the store!
: What?!
: Sorry! I can’t hear you over the mountain of dust I am leaving behind that you are subsequently being buried by!
: That’s not dust at all! It’s sand! And you’re getting it in my cute girl-mouth!
: WHOOOOOOSHHHHH!
: MOUUUUU! MATTE YO SENSEI-KUUUUUUN!~
: I will be up here forever, won’t I?
: Ah!
: What is this?
: It appears I have encountered a seashell. It stopped me in my tracks!
: I should do something about this before Ayane catches up.
: Perhaps if I scoop it up and clean it off, I can present it to her as part of a mating ritual and further earn her favor.
: Sensei!!!!! I’ll never catch up at this- oh, right. I can fly!
: WHEEEEEEE!
: Arnold, look. I found a seashell!
: Whaaaaaaaaat? At the beach?! How?!
: It’s weird, though! When I press my ear to it, I don’t hear the ocean at all! And that’s extra weird because the ocean is right next to us.
: It’s probably because you’re holding it wrong, dummy! It’s dangerous to hold a seashell like that!
: Dangerous? Are you saying it might bite me?
: No, idiot! Seashells don’t have teeth! It’s dangerous for the seashell! Are you trying to break it?!
: Of course not! I only picked it up to earn your favor!
: Look on and be amazed by my manliness and dependability. I am totally prepared to keep this item forever!
: Just give it to me already! I want to hold it! I’ve never gotten to before!
: Yeah, go ahead. I don’t like it. It’s weird.
: Awwwww! It’s not weird at all, Sensei! Seashells are natural and beautiful and-
: Huh?
: Wha- the seashell made you ugly?!?! I don’t like you anymore!
: Huh?! What?! What’s-
: Chotto frickin’ matte, Ayane-chan! You’re not supposed to have that yet!
: Give it here! I’ll put it back where it belongs.
: Ami! You have escaped! I love you the most again. Even if you’re doing weird things with your fingers right now.
: Just making sure she didn’t take any of your parts, Dad!
: Ami?...Sensei?...Why do you look like that?...
: Is it happening again? Are we-
: Aaah....aaaaaaaah!
: Shh! No, no! You’re okay! Don’t be scared~
: What the heck? That seashell sounds nothing like the ocean.
: Because it’s not a seashell at all, Dad! It’s a poisonous fish that washed up on shore. And it’s going to kill us all if we don’t do something about it!
: Oh no! I have endangered Ayane! I feel bad about this even if she is ugly now!
: Give us the fish, woman!
: No...No! You can’t have her! She’s mine! Get away! Both of you!
: It’s already poisoned Ayane! She’s acting delusional!
: Ngh!
: And now she is running away!
: Stop! Thief! That woman stole my fish! She’ll doom us all by replicating it and distributing it to fish markets across Japan!
: Ayane! We can still save you! Don’t make me use my ninja legs!
: MMNMNH?!
: It’s no use, Dad. Once someone’s poisoned by the fish, there is no saving them.
: Even if we get it back, Ayane’s now destined to live a life of panic and anxiety any time the fish isn’t in her sight. She has already imprinted on it and has no use for you anymore.
: Mmmnnnn...
: I know...her freedom is no more.
: It is only misery from here on out.
: I guess that’s why they call it a CAT-fish!
Sensei and Ami went on to live a happy life together in a house decorated with colorful shells.
Ayane was never seen again.
Some say she’s still buried in the sand, patiently waiting to be turned to glass.
